notes: Partition verified: all 21 s### and all 27 t### occur exactly once.

ἐνώπιον is classed improper by rule 95 (lexeme, not the PREP tag) and its frame *in the sight of* stays undivided and headed on *sight* per rule 71; rule 101 keeps the trailing *of* on the adverb because the ASV gives *God* no determiner, so s003 is unrepresented under rule 23 and no bare *of* is left on it (rule 21).

s008 τοῦ → *who* is taken under rule 90 (substantival article before a participle rendered by a single word). The competing reading is rule 31's: if Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ counts as an expressed head noun, τοῦ would be unrepresented and *who* a helper on μέλλοντος. Rule 90 is preferred because Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ is anarthrous, so there is no *second* attributive article for rule 23 to empty, and the corpus reads a loose appositional article+participle after an expressed noun the same way (REV.2.18, REV.2.20).
τὴν ἐπιφάνειαν αὐτοῦ and τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ are ordinary rule 20 displacement; *by* rides with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause since the article is empty.
